caseName: Gilbert v. Washington Beneficial Endowment Ass'n
caseNameFull: Gilbert, Receiver v. Washington Beneficial Endowment Association
summary: Appeal from the Court of Appeals of the District of Columbia.
attorneys: Mr. Thomas M. Fields and Mr. Henry D. Hotchkiss for appellant. Mr. A. A. Lipscomb, Mr. S. F. Phillips, Mr. Frederic D. McKenney, Mr. James E. Padgett and Mr. Edwin Forrest for appellees.
